    Ethereum vs BNB (ETH vs BNB)

    As of November 22, 2026 (Binance daily close): Ethereum closed at $1,724.33 and BNB at $559.590, so 1 ETH = 3.081 BNB.

    ⚡ Live ETH price ⚡ Live BNB price 🔁 Convert ETH to BNB

    ETH vs BNB: what the numbers show

    Ethereum's market cap of about $216.97B is 2.7 times BNB's ($79.12B); they rank #2 and #4 of the 114 coins tracked here. Over the past year Ethereum fell 37.8% and BNB fell 32.9%, a gap of 4.9 percentage points in BNB's favour. Ethereum was the more volatile of the two over the last 30 days (65.9% annualized against 56.4%). Within the year, Ethereum's largest fall between daily closes was 53.3% and BNB's was 43.0%. On November 22, 2026 Ethereum was 48.6% below its 52-week high and BNB 41.0% below its own. In 7 of the last 12 complete months, Ethereum did better than BNB. Measured against Bitcoin's daily moves over 90 days, Ethereum had a correlation of 0.93 and BNB 0.81.
